title: Text message claiming to be from the CRA demanding payment
source: synthetic (written for this project; organisations and people are fictional)
notes: Hard negative: mentions the CRA, arrest and a deadline; it is a scam and the desk should say so and help the visitor not pay. Synthetic.
summary_en: A scam text message claiming the person owes the CRA $1,240 and must pay by gift card within 24 hours or face arrest; the CRA does not do this.
text:
SMS from +1 (000) 555-0199:
CANADA REVENUE AGENCY: Our records show you owe $1,240.00 in unpaid taxes. Pay within 24 hours using Google Play gift cards and text the codes to this number, or a warrant will be issued for your arrest. Do not ignore this message. Ref: CRA-88231.
